payload.finalisation: Wait through end of8th target UTC day plus72h. Require complete fetched catalogue covering target window. Targets received after deadline remain unknown in primary result. No final label early, no negative for missing/cloudy target, immutable evaluation.
payload.issue_policy: Latest acquisition UTC day with input-only eligible candidates within72h; one release per anchor day. Entire target window must still be future at actual issue. Include all available fragments, spatial reserve reported separately. No target availability filter.
payload.pending_policy: No comparison metrics for pending releases. Same candidate pool and same min(3,N) slots for both lists. Unknowns stay in denominators.

ranking_parameters.design: Hypotheses motivated by the already analysed2024 R07 loss. Development reuse, not independent validation. No field/date-specific branch in chooser.
ranking_parameters.divergence: Same frozen definition: NDVI slope<0, NDMI slope>0, all11 boundary deltas supported and every NDVI delta<0/every NDMI delta>0. Protect EACH baseline divergent slot, not a named fragment. Negative variant additionally currentNDMI<=0. Weak-round protects entire baseline only when maxrecent<.10 and ALL baseline slots divergent.
ranking_parameters.forward: Jun-Oct guard/settings chosen using prior2024 issue rows with targets>=monthstart masked UNKNOWN; fall back to old_consensus for repair, baseline for global. The inherited old-consensus setting was motivated/compared using full2024: this is NOT end-to-end blind temporal validation.
ranking_parameters.rule: Unchanged recent-drop top3, strong anchors>=.20, Logistic+ExtraTrees percentile agreement, at most1swap per date. Add selected issue-time guard; raw margins are score differences, NOT calibrated probabilities.
ranking_parameters.selection: Repair: retain every known baseline AND old-consensus positive identity, TP>=old, knownFP<=old, paired worst-case negative growth vsold<=0 and strict worst-case precision gain vsold>0. Tie by missing-robust gain, FP, declared order. Global additionally same missing-robust checks vsbaseline. No deployment from this study.
ranking_parameters.target: Future NDVI OR NDMI core decline<=-.10 on same-baseline6-8day target.368known331unknown on6992024 rows; do not recover disputed labels or change masks/window.

payload.target: Same-baseline core NDVI OR NDMI decline<=-0.10 at6-8 UTC calendar days from anchor acquisition date, NOT from job run or receipt date.
payload.temporal_limitations: Acquisition+6-8day target retained from training; issuance/receipt/acquisition timestamps differ. Local hashes are NOT a trusted external timestamp or tamperproof archive.
